epic.title: epic-567-door: the door is the interface
epic.intent_and_why: The MCP door's tool descriptions now carry what the workbench skill's teaching half taught; sunset the redundant part, keep the templates, without new installer mechanism.

definition_of_done: skills/workbench's teaching content shrunk to only what is genuinely load-bearing.
Full suite green in a clean detached worktree.
Every named spine (Admiral/Commander/Explorer) still reaches its first gate.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Byte-exact retention of the sections two pre-existing test suites pin.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: The named test suites green; the three named scripts' real output recorded; a clean-detached-worktree full suite run.

hard_constraints: No template under skills/workbench/templates/ may move.
No new install_constellation.py mechanism without floating it first.
No file outside skills/workbench/** and docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md may be edited.
fixed_decisions: deregistration mechanism and replacement wording are this lane's own latitude

current_wave.objective: Sunset workbench's teaching half; keep templates; fix #561.
exit_criteria: skills/workbench/SKILL.md, references/checklist-engine.md, references/status-model.md shrunk to evidenced-minimal content.
install_constellation.py, verify_skill_registered.py, measure_overread.py all run against the post-change tree with real, recorded output.
Admiral, Commander, Explorer spines each reach their first gate in a fresh process.
Full suite green (except MapTreeFreshnessTests) in a clean detached worktree.

issues.title: sunset the workbench skill's teaching half
issues.desired_outcome: The redundant teaching content is gone; templates untouched; the skill is deregistered as a taught procedure.
issues.useful_now: The door's own tool descriptions now teach the mechanism, so the CLI/prose duplicate keeps growing back.
issues.appetite: One gate (g1) plus two verification gates (g2, g3).
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: tests/test_mcp_adoption.py, tests/test_commander_evidence_convention.py, tests/test_install_constellation.py, tests/test_retirement_guard.py all green; full suite green.
issues.implementation_latitude: How workbench is deregistered; replacement wording where a reference pointed into the teaching half.
local_unknowns: Whether deregistering a skill that still ships templates is a supported install_constellation.py state -- RESOLVED at understand (q3): not supported; a minimal-but-present SKILL.md is required.

Whether the tracked .agent-work/templates/ overlay references the teaching half -- not investigated this run (out of scope; the overlay is a separate reconciliation surface, not this lane's edit target).
Whether #482's workbench-vs-reviewer dogfooding collision disappears with the teaching half or survives it -- not investigated this run; no evidence either way surfaced.

wave_evidence.observed: Partial redundancy. Two pre-existing test suites (test_mcp_adoption.py Tier2+Tier3, test_install_constellation.py) and files outside this lane's ownership (commander-core.md, REVIEW_RESULT.template.md, IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.template.md, IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md) hard-pin specific sections as the sole written authority for content the door's tool schemas do not restate.
wave_evidence.source: understand interrogation q2, cold plan critic pass, g1-review attempt-1 BLOCK finding

wave_evidence.claim: Deregistering workbench needs no new installer mechanism.
wave_evidence.expected: Unknown going in (a Local Unknown named in the launch order).
wave_evidence.observed: True only if the file stays present with minimal content -- discover_skills() requires a parseable SKILL.md for every non-underscore skills/* directory or the WHOLE installer raises, not just workbench's install.

discrepancies.signal: The issue's original per-file line counts (SKILL.md 43, checklist-engine.md 181, status-model.md 58 = 282; Admiral re-measured 289 on f05a3d78) assumed full deletion was achievable.
discrepancies.affects: How future line-count-style deliverables in this epic should be framed -- as a starting estimate to re-measure, not a fixed target.
discrepancies.evidence: Actual result: SKILL.md 20, checklist-engine.md 65, status-model.md 39 = 124 lines retained (vs. 289 measured before this run); 165 lines actually deleted, not 289.
discrepancies.reason: Reported as the honest-null result per Stop Conditions/Honest-Null Clause -- not an issue-filing trigger, not fixed to match the original estimate.

discrepancies.signal: tests/test_crew_launcher.py::ScratchDirResumeTests::test_resume_of_legacy_entry_without_worktree_key_does_not_crash_and_leaves_scratch_dir_unbound fails when run from a process whose own environment already carries CREW_SCRATCH_DIR (true for any dispatched crew, including this Commander itself under the epic's own dispatch).
discrepancies.affects: Suite reliability for any dispatched-crew-driven CI/local run, not specific to this lane's change.
discrepancies.evidence: Fails in this session's own shell (CREW_SCRATCH_DIR set); passes with `env -u CREW_SCRATCH_DIR` in the same clean detached worktree at the same commit.
discrepancies.reason: A test-isolation gap (the test's fake_launch does not scrub CREW_SCRATCH_DIR before asserting its absence), unrelated to workbench content -- staged as a triage candidate, not fixed here (outside this lane's file ownership: tests/test_crew_launcher.py is not skills/workbench/**).

discrepancies.signal: Running scripts/install_constellation.py without --dry-run (to inspect the installed workbench copy for g2's evidence) mutated this worktree's own .mcp.json (rewrote 'python3' -> 'py' as the probed MCP server command).
discrepancies.affects: Any future verification step that runs a real (non-dry-run) install against the CURRENT worktree rather than an isolated target.
discrepancies.evidence: git diff .mcp.json showed the rewrite; reverted with git checkout -- .mcp.json before committing.
discrepancies.reason: Caught and reverted before commit; reported as a workflow-feedback item, not filed.
